gloss: to keep writing; to continue writing

definitions.gloss: to keep writing; to continue writing
definitions.explanation: To continue the act of writing without stopping. A compound of {書|か}く (to write) and {続|つづ}ける (to continue).

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{続|つづ}ける。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: He kept writing his novel until morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how busy she is, she keeps writing in her diary every day.

notes:
A compound verb: ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) + ⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue). Conjugates as an ichidan verb on the ⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ ending.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive; the thing written takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{続|つづ}ける.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{続|つづ}ける: to keep writing a novel
- ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{書|か}き{続|つづ}ける: to keep writing no matter what

USAGE:
- The pattern verb stem + ⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ attaches to many verbs to mean "keep doing," e.g. ⟦{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける→走り続ける：22070_hashiritsuzukeru⟧ (keep running), ⟦{言|い}い{続|つづ}ける→言い続ける：29059_iitsuzukeru⟧ (keep saying).
